terms.gzip: A common network data compression format. Clients and servers negotiate its use through request headers.
terms.sse: A response style in which the server continuously returns events, commonly used for incremental chat output.
terms.upstream: The model service provider, such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or a compatible gateway.
terms.provider: An organization or gateway that provides model services. Manage it on the Providers page.
terms.probe: Sends one minimal real request upstream to confirm whether it accepts a compressed request body.
terms.egress: Traffic sent from this service to the public internet. Inbound requests are usually not billed.
